newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's JSE says trade to start 15 minutes late.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's JSE says trade to start 15 minutes late.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange said on Tuesday trade would begin 15 minutes later than normal after a test on its electronic Johannesburg Equities Trading system was carried out in the morning.
"We have done a test and it was succesful. The pre-opener will be at 0715 GMT and trade will start at 0745," JSE president Roy Andersen told Reuters.
The exchange's system failed twice on Monday, forcing trade to a halt 50 minutes before the official 1400 GMT closing time.
